title: Getnet Global — Omnichannel Payments
text: Getnet operates an omnichannel payment platform across markets outside Brazil, including Mexico, Chile, Argentina, Uruguay, Colombia, Spain and Portugal, offering in-store, online and mobile payment acceptance with locally tailored solutions.

title: Getnet Global — Scale
text: Getnet is the #1 acquirer in Latin America by transaction volume, processing roughly €238 billion annually across 35 countries with 1.2 million active merchants.

title: Getnet Global — Specialized Solutions
text: Beyond core payment acceptance, Getnet Global offers industry-specific solutions for restaurants, travel, and health & beauty, plus enterprise offerings for international companies and SMEs, alongside emerging services such as agentic-commerce infrastructure and the Getnet Engage loyalty program.
